name: TrueSignal decoy touched from a high-criticality asset
description: A decoy was touched from an address the Hub's Assets page marks high or critical. A production system has no reason to talk to a decoy, so the asset itself is the likely compromised machine. Escalation on top of the per-event rule.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Monitoring, backup or inventory agents on the asset that sweep the decoy subnet.
Asset ranges on the Assets page that are wider than the asset.
note:
## Triage
1. `truesignal.source_asset.name` is the asset; its owner is on the Hub's Assets page.
2. Pull the asset's EDR timeline around `@timestamp` (Falcon process tree for the connecting process).
3. Check for a recent change on the asset (deployment, new monitoring agent) before declaring compromise; then contain.
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and event.kind:"alert" and truesignal.source_asset.criticality:("high" or "critical") and not truesignal.whitelisted:true and not truesignal.known_scanner:true
